name: Under Armour NCAA Pre-National Invitational
where: Terre Haute, IN · host Indiana State · LaVern Gibson Championship Cross Country Course
headline: Under Armour NCAA Pre-National Invitational
summary: Final: Women: No. 2 BYU edged No. 1 NC State 84-88 in the Blue race, with NC State's Hannah Gapes winning individually in 18:57.6; No. 7 Notre Dame was third (213) and No. 23 Clemson fourth (229). Men: No. 8 Syracuse won with 115, ahead of No. 14 Villanova (127) and No. 15 Notre Dame (148), and Tulane's Silas Kiptanui took the individual title in 23:17.4. BYU's Jane Hedengren did not race.
